language_policy.translation_notes: Do not create a Chinese prompt pass for this package.

reference_bindings.scope_notes: Use only for hallway geometry, wall texture, door placement, and floor continuity.
Use only for warm practical light, cool hallway shadow, film texture, and restrained realism.

clip_batches.prompt_text: Vertical 9:16 cinematic live-action realism, 24fps. Use @hallway for the narrow apartment hallway and @style for warm practical light against cool hallway shadow. Shot 1: a wide eye-level view slowly pushes toward the half-open apartment door at the far end; no people are visible, the warm light feels like an invitation with no host. Shot 2: cut to a low medium close-up of the door edge and light spilling over the floorboards; hold the absence, one subtle light flicker only. Shot 3: match cut to an overhead close-up of the empty floor with the warm rectangle of light, the door cropped out, the room tone falling away. Keep movement restrained, one camera movement per shot, no subtitles, no music.
negative_instructions: Do not reveal a person in the doorway.
Do not add horror jump scares, extra props, decorative clutter, subtitles, or music.
continuity_inputs: Preserve the same hallway geometry, door position, floorboards, and warm/cool light relationship across all shots.
clip_batches.export_notes: Three approved storyboard shots fit in one 12 second Seedance batch. If the provider struggles with continuity, split after shot 2 and use the last accepted frame as the next start frame.

audio_text_policy.music_policy: No music unless the artist separately approves a music bed.
audio_text_policy.subtitle_policy: No subtitles in the raw Seedance clip; on-screen title treatment belongs to the approved text track or later edit layer.
audio_text_policy.spoken_line_policy: Do not invent or transcribe new dialogue. Bind approved voiceover audio separately if speech is rendered in-provider.

traceability_summary.note: The prompt preserves absence by forbidding a visible host.
Aspect ratio, shot order, audio posture, and storyboard shot movement come from the approved Video Medium Plan.
The location reference file controls hallway continuity without adding new story material.

critique_checklist: Prompt text is English and does not include a Chinese prompt block.
Every provider tray tag has a reference file and scoped role.
The batch uses no more than six storyboard shots and stays within 4-15 seconds.
No story events, symbols, dialogue, subtitles, music, or visual subjects are invented beyond the approved storyboard package.
